responsibility: This file implements the recording side of libgccjit: the persistent IR built by API calls before compilation starts. It provides dump support, source-replay emission, context-owned allocation helpers, concrete memento subclasses for types, functions, blocks, statements, asm, initializers, and expressions, replay support that forwards recorded operations into playback, and validation/debug-string logic for many IR nodes. Its responsibility is to capture, serialize, and later replay client API activity as libgccjit's stable pre-compilation representation.
same_name_distinction: Defines the recording layer's out-of-line behavior: it implements the memento classes and context operations declared in jit-recording.h, including dumping, source-replay emission, replay into the playback layer, and helper logic such as type comparison. Unlike the header, this .cc file contains the executable implementation of the recorded IR machinery.
